sources.citation: Daniels, Don. 2015. A reconstruction of Proto-Sogeram: Phonology, lexicon, and morphosyntax. PhD dissertation, University of California, Santa Barbara.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Only mention of Magɨyi is p. 659 fn. 21: 'there may still be unsurveyed Sogeram languages to the west of Katiati; Joseph Brooks (p.c.) collected a brief wordlist on a lect from this area that his consultant referred to as "Magɨyi," which closely resembles Mum.' Nothing on Magɨyi phonology or stress (its phonology sections concern other Sogeram languages).
